strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: e tlhola lebokoso la dikonopo la ga jaana kgatlhanong le lenaane la go phimola la Google (CRL) mme e leka metswedi e mentsi go fitlha e bona lebokoso la dikonopo le le dirang, ka bekapo e e itirisang le go simolola gape ga ditirelo tsa Google. E tsamaya mo pompong nngwe le nngwe mme e tlhoka inthanete (metsotso e le 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Lebokoso la dikonopo go tswa mo netewekeng: e laisolola lebokoso la dikonopo go tswa mo polokelong ya semmuso (GitHub) mme e le boloke mo /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. E tlhoka inthanete mme e tsaya metsotso e le 1-3. E dirisiwa fa smart fetch e palelwa kgotsa fa lebokoso la dikonopo le fetotswe ka seatla.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP tlhatlhobo: e tlhola dimmojule tse di leng teng tsa Tlamelo ya Dinotlolo tsa Kgakala, e tlhatlhoba mofuta wa setifikeiti sa netefatso sa TEE, le go bontsha seemo sa sediriswa sa KmInstallKeybox. Ha e fetole letho — pono ya boemo ba sesebediswa se tlwaelehileng.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine tlhola (bala fela): e bontsha Widevine maemo a ditshupo (L1/L3) go tswa go dumpsys, go nna teng ga faele ya selotlolo sa DRM (IDM), le dithoto tsa tsamaiso tse di amanang le tsone. Ga e fetole sepe gotlhelele.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: clears Play Store and Google services (GMS+GSF) data and reboots the device automatically. For stubborn attestation only — it never touches your photos or files.
strings.mdCertify: • Setifikeiti sa go tshameka: se tlhola seemo sa netefatso ya setifikeiti sa RKP sa sediriswa le go seta gape dithoto tsa netefatso fa go tlhokega. Ga e ame tshedimosetso ya modirisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER paakanyo: e baakanya Google letlhomeso la ditirelo (SOTER) dintlha tse di amanang le netefatso ya sediriswa. E dirisiwa mo didirisweng dingwe tse di ikaegileng ka SOTER go na le go Tshameka Botshepegi.
strings.mdPifApply: • Dirisa PIF: e tsamaisa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh maatla. E dirisa kgatiso ya menwana e e tlhophilweng (ya selegae/e e gatetseng pele) le go tlhabolola difaele tsa pif.prop/pif.json. Sephetho se hlakileng se hlahella pegelong.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF tlhola: e bontsha boemo jwa enjene e e tsenngwang, difaele tsa kgatiso ya menwana (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), le dipego. Hlahloba feela - e fetola letho.
strings.mdCanary: • Ntšhwafatso ya Canary: e tsamaisa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. E tsaya tokololo ya bošeng ya Canary Engine go netefatsa gore e tsamaisana le disetifikeiti tsa RKP tse di gapelediwang (Tlhakole 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Diphatlha tsa lebokoso la dikonopo (tsa motheo / tsa bobedi)
strings.hintKbSlots: Mojulung ona laola tse peli keybox slots: mantlha (halalelang, ha ho mohla hlakolwa) le bobeli (bekapo). Thebo ena e bontsha hore na ke sebaka sefe se sebetsang, se fetola kgetho, kapa se kgothaletsa sa bobedi ho ya ho sa mantlha ka kopo e totobetseng — ka dibekapo le pegelo e feletseng.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Tekolo ya botshepehi: e hlahloba TEE senotlolo sa ho reka, ente ya laeborari kahare ho keystore2, boemo ba ho hlakola (CRL), tshireletso-lenane la tshireletso le RKP boemo. Bala-fela — ga e fetole sepe.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Dirisa gape ka pabalesego:

• Lenaane la tshireletso le agiwa sešwa go tswa mo tirisong nngwe le nngwe e e tsenngwang.
• Lera la go tsamaisana ga custom-ROM le dirisiwa gape.
• Lebokoso la dikonopo le le dirang le dirisiwa gape.
#• #1 restarted.

Ga go na sepe se se phimotsweng mme lebokoso la dikonopo la konokono ga le ke le amiwa.

Tswelela?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: e bontsha boemo ba slots tsa mantlha le tsa bobedi mme e fetola kgetho pakeng tsa tsona. Motheo (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) o sireleditswe ka metlha mme ga o ke o phimolwa. Go rotloetsa motheo go ya motheong go tlhoka netefatso e e tlhamaletseng.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Rotloetsa selotlolo sa bobedi go nna sa motheo:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml e nna diteng tsa selotlolo sa motheo.
• Selotlolo sa ga jaana se bolokwa jaaka bekapo pele ga go emisediwa ka se sengwe.
• Ga go na sepe se se phimotsweng — tiro e ka busediwa morago5##00.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Phimola lefelo la bobedi:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml le tla tlosiwa.
• Lefelo la ntlha ga le a amiwa.

Tswelela?

Go tsaya lebokoso la dikonopo le le botlhale (le lesha mo v3.17):

• E tlhola lebokoso la dikonopo la ga jaana kgatlhanong le lenaane la phimolo la Google (CRL).
• E leka metswedi e mentsi go fitlha go bonwa lebokoso la dikonopo le le phepa.
s• Bekapo ya go itirisa +9 ditirelo.

strings.confirmKbNet:
Tsaya lebokoso la dikonopo mo inthaneteng:

• E laisolola lebokoso la dikonopo la semmuso le go le netefatsa.
• E tsentswe ruri (ga e ise e ko e busediwe morago fa e simolola).

⚠️ E tlhoka inthanete (go fitlha go motsotso o le 1). Tswelela?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Go tlamela gape RKP dinotlolo:

• Ga go na tshedimosetso kgotsa difaele tsa lebokoso la dinotlolo tse di phimotsweng.
• Simolola founo gape morago ga moo.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Paakanyo e e feletseng:

• E tlamela gape RKP + e simolola gape Google ditirelo.
• Sediriswa se simolola gape ka go itirisa (ga go na sepe se se phimotsweng).

Tswelela?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Simolola gape ditirelo tsa Google:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — simolola gape fela.
• Ga go na sepe se se phimotsweng mme GA O kitla o tswa.
• Sediriswa se simolola gape ka go itirisa.#000e#65
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Pateletsa go tlamela gape (Red Magic):

• Mo didirisweng tse di itlhokomolosang lebokoso la dinotlolo le le dutlileng.
• E dira le fa dinotlolo di itekanetse.
• Ga go na tshedimosetso e e phimotsweng.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmCertify:
Pateletsa Play Store setifikeiti:

• E phimola fela polokelotlaleletso ya Lebenkele — akhaonto ya gago ga e a amiwa.
• Simolola gape, o bo o bula Lebenkele.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER paakanyo:

• E simolola tirelo ya vendor.soter gape.
• E phimola tshedimosetso ya sefara ya SOTER fela.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Dirisa kgatiso ya menwana (PIF):

• E fetola custom.pif.prop le go e tsenya mo tseleng ya enjene.
• E tlhoka go simolola gape morago ga moo.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmCanary:
Ntšhwafatsa kgatiso ya menwana ya Canary:

• E laisolola kgatiso ya menwana ya bošeng ya semmuso ya Canary go tswa go Google.
• E tsamaisanya patch ya tshireletso + e simolola gape ditirelo tsa Google (ga go phimolwe).

⚠️ mets 1). Tswelela?
